description.ncbi_summary: Predicted to enable GDP binding activity; GTP binding activity; and GTPase activity. Predicted to be involved in Ras protein signal transduction. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Apr 2022]

uniprot_function.text: The small GTPases Rab are key regulators of intracellular membrane trafficking, from the formation of transport vesicles to their fusion with membranes. Rabs cycle between an inactive GDP-bound form and an active GTP-bound form that is able to recruit to membranes different sets of downstream effectors directly responsible for vesicle formation, movement, tethering and fusion (By similarity). The physiological function of RAB42 remains undefined (Probable).
